title: Hs Verity File — anti-specification machine-readable form
description: Machine-readable companion to ANTI_SPECIFICATION.md per engine/wrapper/paper. Records the SEA (Suspicion of Every Assumption) failure-mode enumeration with mitigation evidence and residual-risk classification. See docs/SUSPICION_OF_EVERY_ASSUMPTION.md for the doctrine.

verity_id.description: Identifier of this verity record, e.g., 'cnq-engine-verity/2.0' or 'wrapper-audio-verity/1.0'.

subject.description: What this verity record covers, e.g., 'HCI-CNQ engine v2.0.0', 'Audio wrapper', 'Paper 1 universality result'.

subject_version.description: Version of the subject under audit (e.g., '2.0.0', 'audio-wrapper/1.0').

subject_path.description: Repository-relative path to the subject artifact.

doctrine_version.description: Version of the SEA doctrine this record conforms to.

auditor.description: Person or process responsible for this audit pass.

last_audited.description: ISO-8601 date of the most recent audit pass.

next_audit_due.description: ISO-8601 date by which the next audit pass should occur.

release_gate_pass.description: True iff unverified_count == 0 and no acknowledged_limitation entries are unintentional.

id.description: Failure mode ID, e.g., 'NUM_001', 'ALG_017', 'INTP_002'. Three-or-four-letter category code, underscore, three-digit sequence.

category.description: Failure-mode category. See SUSPICION_OF_EVERY_ASSUMPTION.md §4 for definitions.

failure_mode.description: Brief description of what would go wrong if this failure occurred.

conditions.description: Input or runtime conditions that would trigger this failure.

mitigation.description: How the engine prevents or bounds this failure.

residual_risk.description: What remains uncovered after mitigation. See doctrine §6.

reference.description: Pointer to the evidence: file path + identifier, equation reference, dataset path, etc.

verified_at.description: When this evidence was last confirmed to hold.
